tells.1: The stacked conversational touches—“We can't wait to see it,” “Maybe you,” “Either way”—feel slightly engineered for informality.
tells.2: Stock warmth: “heartfelt thank you,” “a welcome addition to the team” and “a reminder of what your support makes possible.”
tells.3: The seasonal opening and “glad to have it joining the team” add somewhat formulaic warmth.
tells.6: “As autumn settles over the hills” feels like a decorative stock opening, awkwardly attached to the direct thank-you.

reason: Version 4 is clear, credible and welcoming, with the restraint of a skilled newsletter editor; version 1 has more personality but occasionally sounds rehearsed. These are stylistic judgments, not reliable evidence of AI authorship: version 5 feels plausibly human but is the least polished.
